The preview failure came from the `open_preview` tool. It tried to reach the app at `127.0.0.1:5173` and got `ECONNREFUSED`, which means nothing was accepting connections on that port — the intended app server had been stopped. The address and port were correct; there was simply no listener behind them.

Starting that server and retrying the same selected URL cleared the error, so the preview is now available. Note that this only confirms the preview is reachable: browser verification of the app itself has not run yet.
